layout.header: compact sticky white capsule with logo at left, Lavoro centered, and cominciamo at right
layout.hero: light canvas and brand-tint field, centered static headline, changing service label, responsive device below
layout.desktopDevice: laptop frame with three concept screens
layout.mobileDevice: phone frame with vertically adapted, scrollable concept screens below 640px
layout.contact: compact local demo form below hero
layout.mobile: single-line capsule navigation, natural hero height, touch controls

motion.serviceLabel: short opacity and vertical transition on service change
motion.deviceAutoplay: slow rotation until manual selection; pause offscreen or hidden tab
motion.reducedMotion: disable autoplay and service-label animation; keep manual controls

interactions.contactForm: native validation and local confirmation only; no sending or storage
interactions.ecommerceCart: increments local count and confirms action; no order or persistence

contentPolicy.claims: no invented customers, testimonials, metrics, or outcomes
